patch_translations.source: Storage bridges work with more than just ordinary containers. Almost any object which can be interacted with that has item slots can be linked to a storage bridge. This includes some FrackinUniverse crafting stations and a few misc. objects that might already have power nodes (but no input/output nodes). If you find yourself uncertain about which nodes to use, remember that storage bridge nodes always function as ITN input/output nodes.
patch_translations.canonical_source: Storage bridges work with more than just ordinary containers. Almost any object which can be interacted with that has item slots can be linked to a storage bridge. This includes some FrackinUniverse crafting stations and a few misc. objects that might already have power nodes (but no input/output nodes). If you find yourself uncertain about which nodes to use, remember that storage bridge nodes always function as ITN input/output nodes.
patch_translations.translation: ストレージブリッジは、通常のコンテナ以上のもので動作する。 アイテムスロットを持つオブジェクトと対話できるオブジェクトは、ほとんどすべてストレージブリッジにリンクすることができます。 これには、いくつかのFrackinUniverseクラフトステーションといくつかのミスが含まれます。 すでにパワーノードがあるかもしれないオブジェクト(入出力ノードがない)。 使用するノードが不確かであれば、ストレージブリッジノードは常にITNの入出力ノードとして機能することを忘れないでください。

patch_translations.source: Object Data Sensor: Crafted in the tinkering table. Detects object placement points, to allow for more precise placement of Storage Bridges. Bridges select a single container based on the distance between themselves and object placement points.
patch_translations.canonical_source: Object Data Sensor: Crafted in the tinkering table. Detects object placement points, to allow for more precise placement of Storage Bridges. Bridges select a single container based on the distance between themselves and object placement points.
patch_translations.translation: 物体データセンサー: いじり台で作ったもの。 オブジェクト配置点を検出し、より正確なストレージブリッジの配置を可能にします。 ブリッジは、自分自身とオブジェクトの配置点との距離に基づいて単一のコンテナを選択します。

patch_translations.source: Item Transference Devices (ITDs) are additional core components of the ITN system. While ITDs are capable of moving all items by default, you will need special token items to filter for currencies or items the ITD does not recognize. You can place them wherever you want as long as you can keep their wiring straight. Mastery of the ITD will bring mastery over the entire ITN system.
patch_translations.canonical_source: Item Transference Devices (ITDs) are additional core components of the ITN system. While ITDs are capable of moving all items by default, you will need special token items to filter for currencies or items the ITD does not recognize. You can place them wherever you want as long as you can keep their wiring straight. Mastery of the ITD will bring mastery over the entire ITN system.
patch_translations.translation: アイテム転送デバイス(ITD)はITNシステムのコアコンポーネントである。 ITDはデフォルトですべてのアイテムを移動することができますが、ITDが認識していない通貨やアイテムをフィルタリングする特別なトークンアイテムが必要になります。 配線をまっすぐに保てる限り、どこにでも配置できます。 ITDの習得はITNシステム全体の習得をもたらす。

patch_translations.source: Overflow: ITDs will sound off alarms if you are trying to move too much into a container that does not have space. They will also slow down their processing speed. If you have alarms sounding and periodic lag, you should work on improving flow control.
patch_translations.canonical_source: Overflow: ITDs will sound off alarms if you are trying to move too much into a container that does not have space. They will also slow down their processing speed. If you have alarms sounding and periodic lag, you should work on improving flow control.
patch_translations.translation: オーバーフロー: スペースのないコンテナにあまり移動しようとすると、ITDはアラームを鳴らします。 また、処理速度も遅くなります。 アラームの鳴りと周期的な遅延がある場合は、流量制御の改善に取り組む必要があります。

patch_translations.source: Stack Move: To move stacks of specific sizes, place the desired stack size in your filter area. This works well with Even Split and Slot Split, as it will only move stacks there are enough to do so equally. It does not, however, account for amounts in the destination.
patch_translations.canonical_source: Stack Move: To move stacks of specific sizes, place the desired stack size in your filter area. This works well with Even Split and Slot Split, as it will only move stacks there are enough to do so equally. It does not, however, account for amounts in the destination.
patch_translations.translation: スタック移動: 特定のサイズのスタックを移動させるには、希望するスタックサイズをフィルター領域に配置します。 スタックを均等に移動できるのが十分なので、Event SplitとSlot Splitではこれがうまく機能します。 ただし、目的地の金額は考慮されません。

patch_translations.source: In order to set up a basic ITN network, connect the red output node for a container's storage bridge to the second blue input node for an ITD, and then connect the ITD's red output node to the blue input node of a second container's storage bridge. Now all items put into the first container will be automatically moved to the second one.
patch_translations.canonical_source: In order to set up a basic ITN network, connect the red output node for a container's storage bridge to the second blue input node for an ITD, and then connect the ITD's red output node to the blue input node of a second container's storage bridge. Now all items put into the first container will be automatically moved to the second one.
patch_translations.translation: 基本的なITNネットワークを設定するには、コンテナのストレージブリッジ用の赤い出力ノードをITD用の二番目の青い入力ノードに接続し、ITDの赤い出力ノードを二番目のコンテナのストレージブリッジの青い入力ノードに接続します。 これで、最初のコンテナに入れられたすべてのアイテムが自動的に二番目のコンテナに移動されます。

patch_translations.source: ITDs can be interacted with to bring up their configuration menu. Input slots indicate what slots in a container the ITD will pull from; output slots designate what inventory slots in a container the ITD will drop items into. You can press the red I button to invert the selected slots, telling the ITD to ignore those specific slots rather than use them specifically. Even splitting and slot splitting dictate whether the ITD sorts items into single stacks or splits items between every indicated output slot. ITDs may not be used as repeaters.

You can press the red I button to invert the selected slots, telling the ITD to ignore those specific slots rather than use them specifically. Even splitting and slot splitting dictate whether the ITD sorts items into single stacks or splits items between every indicated output slot. ITDs may not be used as repeaters.
patch_translations.translation: ITDは、設定メニューを作成するために対話することができます。 入力スロットは、ITDがコンテナ内のどのスロットから取得するかを示し、出力スロットは、ITDがアイテムをドロップするコンテナ内のどのインベントリスロットを指定する。 赤のIボタンを押すと、選択したスロットを反転させ、ITDに特定のスロットを具体的に使うのではなく、無視するように指示することができます。 分割やスロット分割でさえ、ITDがアイテムを単一のスタックに分類するか、表示された出力スロットごとにアイテムを分割するかを決定する。 ITDはリピーターとして使用することはできません。

patch_translations.source:
Alicorns are the curious combination of Earth Ponies, Unicorns and Pegasi, known to be deities in equine folklore. While they're theoretically the strongest, practically it mostly relays to their innate charismatic abilities and diverse skills among the board.

  ^orange;Diet^reset;: Herbivore

^orange;Perks^reset;:
  +^green;10^reset;% Charisma. Health x^green;1.05^reset;, +^green;7^reset;% E. Regen, Fall Damage x^green;0.7^reset;
  ^cyan;Immune^reset;: Aether
  ^cyan;Racial Ability^cyan;: Earth Pony Stomp, Unicorn Glow, Pegasus Flight

^orange;Environment^reset;:
  Aether and Crystalline: Energy x^green;1.05^reset;, Health x^green;1.1^reset;, +^green;20^reset;% E. Regen

^orange;Weapons^reset;:
  +^green;15^reset;% Staff, Broadsword and Assault Rifle Mastery

^orange;Weaknesses^reset;:
  ^red;Requires twice as much food to sustain themselves^reset;, +^red;60%^reset; Energy Block time.

^orange;Resistances^reset;:
  -^red;25^reset;% Physical and Knockback, +^green;15^reset;% Cosmic and Shadow.

patch_translations.translation:
アリコーンは、馬の民間伝承で神とされる、アースポニー・ユニコーン・ペガサスの不思議な混成種だ。理論上は最強だが、実際の強みは、生まれ持ったカリスマと幅広い能力にある。

  ^orange;食性^reset;：草食

^orange;特性^reset;：
  カリスマ+^green;10^reset;%。体力×^green;1.05^reset;、エネルギー再生+^green;7^reset;%、落下ダメージ×^green;0.7^reset;
  ^cyan;無効化^reset;：エーテル
  ^cyan;種族能力^cyan;：アースポニーの踏みつけ、ユニコーンの発光、ペガサスの飛行

^orange;環境^reset;：
  エーテル・水晶：エネルギー×^green;1.05^reset;、体力×^green;1.1^reset;、エネルギー再生+^green;20^reset;%

^orange;武器^reset;：
  杖・大剣・アサルトライフルの習熟度+^green;15^reset;%

^orange;弱点^reset;：
  ^red;生存に必要な食料が二倍^reset;、エネルギー回復停止時間+^red;60%^reset;。

^orange;耐性^reset;：
  物理・ノックバック-^red;25^reset;%、宇宙属性・闇+^green;15^reset;%。

patch_translations.source: The Anodyne are a mysterious race of 'interstellar gas-bag people' much like the Novakid. They have no charted settlements and no documented history. They're volatile beings, untroubled by the past. No one knows what they're made of, much less where they came from.
patch_translations.canonical_source: The Anodyne are a mysterious race of 'interstellar gas-bag people' much like the Novakid. They have no charted settlements and no documented history. They're volatile beings, untroubled by the past. No one knows what they're made of, much less where they came from.
patch_translations.translation: アノダインはノヴァキッドに似た、謎多き「星間ガス生命体」の種族。居住地の記録も、書き残された歴史もない。気まぐれで、過去にとらわれない存在だ。何でできているのか、ましてやどこから来たのか、誰も知らない。

The Kyani are a species of scientists and crafters. Surprisingly, they're the first to be fully made of metallic elements. Their tech went REALLY far ahead, but they're reluctant to share it with others.

Diet: Anything

^orange;Perks^reset;:

^yellow;Lush and Forest^reset; - ^yellow;-15%^reset; Health and Energy

A mysterious race of cave dwellers known for their underground cities and love for treasure. Adapted to the deep underground, they can jump high and take less fall damage. Due to their impressive eyesight, they have higher precision with weapons.

  ^orange;Diet^reset;: Omnivore, can eat raw meat.

^orange;Perks^reset;:
  +^green;15^reset;% Jump, +^green;5^reset;% Speed
  ^green;Resist^reset;: +^green;40^reset;% Fire, +^green;10^reset;% Poison, +^green;10^reset;% Shadow
  Fall Damage x^green;0.5^reset;
  ^green;Medium visibility in darkness^reset;
  ^cyan;Immune^reset;: Moderate Heat, Mud

^orange;Weapons^reset;:
  Shortsword: Damage x^green;1.12^reset; and +^green;20^reset;% Knockback Resistance
  Dagger and Spear: Damage x^green;1.12^reset; and +^green;5^reset;% Crit Chance
  Machine pistol: Damage x^green;1.1^reset; and +^green;1^reset;% Crit Damage
  Sniper Rifle: +^green;3^reset;% Crit Chance and +^green;10^reset;% Crit Damage
  Shotgun: Damage x^green;1.12^reset; and +^green;10^reset;% Crit Damage
  Boomerang and Chakram: Damage x^green;1.12^reset; and +^green;2^reset; Defense
  Shield: Perfect Blocks ^green;increase Defense^reset;(stacks)

^red;Weaknesses^reset;:
  ^red;Resist^reset;: -^red;30^reset;%Electric, -^red;40^reset;%Ice
  ^red;Sunlight and irradiated planets^reset;:
    ^red;Reduced Energy, Health and Radiation Resistance^reset;.

Evolved in the depths of a Penumbral world, the Nightar dislike light intensely. They are able warriors and capable spies.

  ^orange;Diet^reset;: Omnivore

^orange;Perks^reset;:
  Tech: ^green;Conshak^reset;(light aura, detect monsters, resist damage. ^red;7s charge^reset;)
  ^green;Resist^reset;: +^cyan;15^reset;% Shadow, +^cyan;10^reset;% Poison, +^cyan;5^reset;% Ice
  ^cyan;Immune^reset;: Poisoned

^orange;Environment^reset;:
  ^green;Darkness^reset;: Increases ^green;Physical Res.^reset; and ^green;Damage^reset;. Draining strikes.
  ^red;Light^reset;: Reduces ^red;Energy, Health, Physical Resistance and Damage^reset;. Cancels ^red;Drain effect^reset; of attacks.

^orange;Weapons^reset;:
  All Swords: ^green;3^reset;% Shadow Burst Chance (^green;5 damage^reset;) in darkness.
  Broadsword Mastery : ^green;25^reset;%
  Shortsword Mastery : ^green;25^reset;%
  Longsword Mastery : ^green;25^reset;%
  Shield: +^green;25^reset;% Knockback Resist

^red;Weaknesses^reset;:
  ^red;Resist^reset;: -^red;20^reset;% Cosmic, -^red;15^reset;% Electric

patch_translations.source:
The octopus cousins of Inklings, famous for their skills in engineering, hacking and electronic music. They're a bit more shy than their relatives, but often more wily, using their own venom in some weapons. Most of them hail from the militaristic Octarian Shogunate, and continue to seek the peace it provides them.
 
^orange;Diet^reset;: Omnivore, but can eat raw fish and meat.

^orange;Perks^reset;:
  ^green;220^reset;s Breath
  ^green;Resist^reset;: +^green;30^reset;% Poison, +^green;30^reset;% Radioactive
  ^green;20^reset;% Jump Height increase
  Fall Damage x^green;0.65^reset;.
  ^cyan;Immune^reset;: Slime, Wet, Tar
  ^cyan;Swim Boost 1^reset;

^orange;Environment^reset;:
  On Ocean biomes: Health, Energy & Movement Speed x^green;1.15^reset;, Inf Oxygen, Fall Damage Immunity.
  On Warm biomes: Health, Energy & Movement Speed x^green;1.1^reset;, +^green;10^reset;% regen rate.
  On Cold biomes: Health, Energy & Movement Speed x^red;0.8^reset;, -^red;20^reset;% regen rate.
  Oil, Slime, Dark Water, or Healing Water: Health and Energy x^green;1.1^reset;, Inf Breath
  Poison, Swamp Water, Contaminated Water, or Strange Ooze: Health and Energy x^red;0.7^reset;, -100 Breath

^orange;Weapons^reset;:
  Pistol: Damage x^green;1.2^reset;, Energy x^green;1.15^reset;
  Fist, Shotgun & Broadsword: +^green;2^reset;% Crit Chance, +^green;5^reset;% Crit Damage
  Energy Weapon: Damage x^green;1.05^reset;, Energy x^green;1.05^reset; increase

^red;Weaknesses^reset;:
  ^red;Resist^reset;: -^red;20^reset;% Ice & Electric

patch_translations.translation:
Inklingsのタコのいとこは、エンジニアリング、ハッキング、電子音楽のスキルで有名です。 彼らは親戚よりも少し内気ですが、多くの場合、いくつかの武器で自身の毒を使用している。 彼らのほとんどは軍国主義的なオクタリアの幕府から召集され、それがもたらす平和を求め続ける。
 
^orange;食性^reset;:雑食ですが、生の魚や肉を食べることができます。

^orange;特性^reset;
  ^green;220^reset; 呼吸します。
  ^green;耐性^reset;:+^green;30^reset;%毒、+^green;30^reset;%放射性
  ^green;20^reset;% ジャンプの高さを上げます。
  フォールダメージx^green;0.65^reset;。
  ^cyan;免疫^reset; : スライム, 濡れ, タール
  ^cyan;水泳ブースト1^reset;

^orange;環境^reset;
  海洋生物相について : 体力・エネルギー・移動速度x^green;1.15^reset;酸素では、免疫を低下させる。
  ウォームバイオームについて:体力、エネルギー&移動速度x ^green;1.1^reset;、+^green;10^reset;%再生率。
  寒いバイオームについて:体力、エネルギー&移動速度x ^red;0.8^reset;、-^red;20^reset;%再生率。
  油、スライム、暗水、癒し水:体力とエネルギーx^green;1.1^reset;息を吸って
  毒、水、汚染水、または奇妙なおしっこ:体力とエネルギーx ^red;0.7^reset; 、 -100 呼吸。

^orange; 武器 ^reset; :
  ピストル: ダメージ x ^green;1.2^reset; エネルギー x ^green;1.15^reset; 。
  拳、銃、剣:+^green;2^reset;%クリティカル 機会、+^green;5^reset;%クリティカル 損傷。
  エネルギー兵器:損傷x ^green;1.05^reset;、エネルギーx ^green;1.05^reset;。

^red;弱点^reset;:
  ^red;耐性^reset;:-^red;20^reset;%氷&電気。

patch_translations.translation:
ウマの民俗学のペガシは、気象操作と偉大なチラシであることが知られています。 宇宙飛行技術が発展すると、彼らは世界を植民地化し、彼らのルールに曲げ始めました。 また、多用途の戦士として知られており、射程を使って敵を容易に撃退している。

  ^orange;食性^reset;:草食動物

^orange;特性^reset;
  エネルギーx^green;1.05^reset;, +^green;5^reset;% E.レーゲン +^green;10^reset;% スピード +^green;25^reset;% ジャンプ・フォール・ダメージx^green;0.7^reset;, ^green;+60^reset; 酸素
  ^cyan;免疫^reset; : 電気, 中等度コールド
  ^cyan;人種的能力^reset;:ペガサス飛行

^orange;環境^reset;
  火山と冬:体力x^red;0.95^reset; そして -^red;25^reset;% E.レーゲン

^orange; 武器 ^reset; :
  +^green;15%^reset;クロスボウ、グレネードランチャーとアサルトライフルマスター、+^green;10%^reset;狙撃ライフルマスター。

^orange;弱点^reset;:
  体力 x ^red;0.9^reset;. +^red;20^reset;% 飢餓ドレイン

^orange;レジスタンス^reset;:
  +^red;20^reset;% 氷と電気、-^red;20^reset;% 物理、-^red;10^reset;% 火災 ^red;-50^reset;% ノックバックします。

  ^orange;Diet^reset;: Any, including prepared Isotopes.

^orange;Perks^reset;:
  Health x^green;1.1^reset;, Energy x^green;1.2^reset;, ^red;Reduced by Hunger^reset;. Defense x^green;1.03^reset;
  ^green;Resist^reset;: +^green;35^reset;% Radiation, +^green;10^reset;% Poison, +^green;5^reset;% Cosmic, ^green;Up to 2x when Full Belly^reset;. +^green;5^reset;% Mental.
  Tech: Seed Bulb.
  ^cyan;Immune^reset;: Radiation Burn

^orange;Environment^reset;:
  ^green;Radioactive^reset; biomes: Damage x^green;1.15^reset;, +^green;15^reset;% E. Regen, -^green;5^reset;% Hunger Drain
  ^red;Hot^reset; biomes: Defense x^red;0.85^reset;, +^red;35^reset;% Hunger Drain.
  ^green;Defense increases over time^reset;
  ^cyan;Racial Tech is integral to success^reset;.
  ^green;Passively generate Genes^reset;.

^orange;Weapons^reset;:
  X'i Weapons: +^green;1.5^reset;% Crit Chance, Defense x^green;1.15^reset;

^red;Weaknesses^reset;:
  +^red;25^reset;% Hunger drain.
  ^red;Resist^reset;: -^red;20^reset;% Fire, Ice & Electric, ^red;Up to 1.5x when Hungry^reset;.
  ^red;CANNOT^reset; use Healing items. Must use racial heals.

patch_translations.source:
The Remorian are a species of aquatic dragonoid people that draw energy from the ocean and other humid environments.

  ^orange;Diet^reset;: Omnivore

  Playstyle: ^yellow;Fighting^reset;

^orange;Perks^reset;:
  Energy x^green;1.1^reset;, Damage x^green;1.05^reset;, +^green;15^reset;% E. Regen.
  ^green;Resist^reset;: +^green;20^reset;% Shadow, +^green;10^reset;% Ice
  ^green;1500^reset; Breath, ^cyan;Swim Boost 1^reset;,
  +^green;5^reset;% Speed

^orange;Environment^reset;:
  Oceanic/Wet biomes: Energy x^green;1.1^reset;, Health x^green;1.05^reset;, +^green;15^reset;% E. Regen, +^green;20^reset;% Speed
  Jungle/Humid biomes: Energy x^green;1.05^reset;
  Hot/Dry biomes: Health & Energy x^red;0.85^reset; -^red;30% E. Regen^reset;
  In Water, Healing Water, Waste Water, or Swamp Water: Energy x^green;1.35^reset; and ^cyan;Minor Regeneration^reset;

^orange;Weapons^reset;:
  Shortspear/Spear/Quarterstaff: Damage x^green;1.1^reset;, Defense +^green;5^reset;
  Wands/Staves: Damage & Energy x^green;1.08^reset;
  Broadswords/Shortswords/Daggers: Damage x^green;1.15^reset;, +^green;5^reset;% Crit Chance
  Dual Wield Daggers: +^green;8^reset;% Crit Chance, +^green;25^reset;% Crit Damage, +^green;8^reset;% Speed
  Shortsword + Shield: +^green;8^reset; Defense, -^red;10^reset;% Speed

^red;Weaknesses^reset;:
  Health x^red;0.95^reset;, Defense x^red;0.9^reset;, +^red;5^reset;% Hunger Drain
  ^red;Resist^reset;: -^red;20^reset;% Radioactive, -^red;30^reset;% Electric

Having broken from the shackles of their former abusive owners, they venture space aimlessly, hoping to find a better purpose, make it a worthy equal or a purer cause.

  ^orange;Diet^reset;: Any

^orange;Perks^reset;:
  +^green;1920^reset; Breath Time (4 mins)
  ^green;Resist^reset;: +^green;30^reset;% Ice, +^green;15^reset;% Shadow, Cosmic
  Tech: ^green;Invoke Madness^reset;
  ^cyan;Immune^reset;: Slime Bounce, Slime Stick, Insanity

^orange;Environment^reset;:
  Gelatinous and fleshy biomes: Health x^green;1.25^reset;
  Cold Biomes: Damage and Defense x^green;1.15^reset;
  Hot Biomes: Energy and Defense x^red;0.8^reset;

^orange;Weapons^reset;:
  Claws/Fists: +^green;25^reset;% Movement Speed
  Bio/Slime/Living Weapons: Defense x^green;1.15^reset;, +^green;15^reset;% E. Regen

^red;Weaknesses^reset;:
  ^red;Resist^reset;: -^red;30^reset;% Fire, -^red;10^reset;% Electric
  +^red;20^reset;% Hunger Drain

Once invaded by an alien force which forced them to focus on their military and their defenses, they're extraordinary well trained fighters. Their aquatic origins make them especially dangerous in water and make them a force to be reckoned with.

  ^orange;Diet^reset;: Omnivore

^orange;Perks^reset;:
  Energy x^green;1.05^reset;, +^green;5^reset; Defense, +^green;500^reset; Breath

  ^cyan;Swim Boost 2^reset;

^orange;Environment^reset;:
  Ocean biomes: Health x^green;1.25^reset; and +^green;6^reset; Defense
  Hot biomes: Energy x^red;0.7^reset;, Health x^red;0.7^reset;, Speed x^red;0.8^reset;
  (Healing/Waste/Swamp) Water: +^green;0.1^reset;% Health Regen

  Assault Rifle Mastery: +^green;25^reset;%

The unicorns are tricky ones of the bunch. Despite being frailer than their kin and their weakness to going mad from revelations, their magical powers and their affinity to cosmic energy are quite great. They value themselves as craftsponies more, their magic being in most cases mundane.

  ^orange;Diet^reset;: Herbivore

^orange;Perks^reset;:
  Energy +^green;20%^reset;, Damage +^green;5%^reset;, +^green;15^reset;% E. Regen
  ^cyan;Immune^reset;: Aether
  ^cyan;Racial Ability: Unicorn Glow^reset;

^orange;Environment^reset;:
  Aether/Crystalline: Energy x^green;1.1^reset;, and +^green;10^reset;% Physical Resist.
  Atropus: -^red;10^reset;% E. Regen, Damage and Energy x^red;0.9^reset;

^orange;Weapons^reset;:
  +^green;20^reset;% Staff Mastery, +^green;10^reset;% Wands and Energy

^orange;Weaknesses^reset;:
  Defense x^red;0.9^reset;.
  ^red;25% more suspectible to madness effects, harder to cure madness.^reset;

^orange;Resists^reset;:
 +^green;20^reset;% Cosmic, +^green;5^reset;% Fire, Ice, Electric, Poison, -^red;20^reset;% Shadow, -^red;15^reset;% Radiation.

patch_translations.source:
Zoroark are bipedal fox-like beings that use illusions to fool their prey or predators, to hide their territory, or to protect their young. Like a handful of other races, they too escaped the destruction of Earth. However, it is unclear whether the remaining Pokemon or their trainers escaped the destruction.

  ^orange;Diet^reset;: Omnivore

^orange;Perks^reset;:
  +^green;15^reset;% Speed, +^green;10^reset;% Jump
  Damage x^green;1.1^reset;, Energy x^green;1.05^reset;
  ^green;Resist^reset;: +^green;25^reset;% Shadow, +^green;10^reset;% Cosmic
  ^cyan;Immune^reset;: Jungle, Mud

^orange;Environment^reset;:
  Damage and Physical resistance lowered during the day, and heightened during the night
  Midnight, Lightless, Penumbra: Energy x^green;1.15^reset;, Health x^green;1.1^reset;

^orange;Weapons^reset;:
  Broadsword/Shortsword/Spear/Shortspear/Scythe/Rapier/Dagger: Damage x^green;1.05^reset;
  Energy Weapons: Damage x^green;1.15^reset;, +^green;2^reset;% Crit Chance

^red;Weaknesses^reset;:
  Defense x^red;0.8^reset;, Health x^red;0.95^reset;,
  ^red;Resist^reset;: -^red;45^reset;% Physical

patch_translations.translation:
ゾロアークは二足歩行する狐に似た存在で、幻影を使って獲物や捕食者を欺き、縄張りを隠し、子どもを守る。ほかのいくつかの種族と同じく、地球の滅亡を逃れてきた。しかし、残されたポケモンやトレーナーたちが無事に逃げ延びたかどうかは分かっていない。

  ^orange;食性^reset;: 雑食

^orange;特性^reset;:
  +^green;15^reset;% 移動速度、+^green;10^reset;% ジャンプ力
  ダメージ x^green;1.1^reset;、エネルギー x^green;1.05^reset;
  ^green;耐性^reset;: +^green;25^reset;% 闇、+^green;10^reset;% 宇宙
  ^cyan;無効化^reset;: ジャングル、泥

^orange;環境^reset;:
  昼間はダメージと物理耐性が低下し、夜間は上昇する
  ミッドナイト、無光、ペナンブラ: エネルギー x^green;1.15^reset;、体力 x^green;1.1^reset;

^orange;武器^reset;:
  大剣 / 片手剣 / 槍 / 短槍 / 大鎌 / レイピア / 短剣: ダメージ x^green;1.05^reset;
  エネルギー武器: ダメージ x^green;1.15^reset;、+^green;2^reset;% クリティカル率

^red;弱点^reset;:
  防御力 x^red;0.8^reset;、体力 x^red;0.95^reset;
  ^red;耐性^reset;: -^red;45^reset;% 物理
